observations.description: Palm appears broad and slightly rectangular, with a relatively long palm length compared with the width.
Fingers appear long and fairly straight. The middle finger is the longest; the ring and index fingers are close in length, and the little finger is shorter and set slightly apart.
Thumb is held open at a wide angle from the palm, with visible crease lines at the thumb joints.
observations.location: Left side of image, thumb area

observations.description: A clear upper transverse line runs from the outer edge below the little finger across the upper palm toward the index/middle finger area. It is slightly curved and has small fine branches and interruptions along it.

A long, distinct line begins near the space between the thumb and index finger and travels diagonally downward across the palm toward the outer/lower side. It appears deeper through the center and has intersecting fine lines.
A prominent curved line begins near the thumb-index area and arcs around the base of the thumb toward the wrist. It is well defined, with several smaller lines crossing or running near it.
observations.location: Around the mount at the base of the thumb

observations.description: A vertical to slightly diagonal central line is visible rising from the lower palm toward the middle of the palm, crossing other major lines and becoming less clear higher up.
Several diagonal branch lines cross the central palm, including lines moving from the lower thumb-side area toward the outer upper palm and lines intersecting the head and fate-line region.
The area at the base of the thumb appears full and heavily lined with many fine cross-lines.
The outer lower palm appears broad with multiple fine diagonal and vertical markings.
observations.location: Lower outer palm opposite the thumb

observations.description: The padded areas below the index, middle, ring, and little fingers are visible with fine texture and minor lines; the area below the ring finger is partly obscured by a ring.
Fine cross-hatching and small intersecting lines are visible throughout the palm, especially near the thumb base and central lower palm. No single isolated symbol is clearly dominant.
observations.location: Across palm, strongest in lower and thumb-side areas

observations.description: A metal ring on the ring finger partially hides skin creases and the base of that finger.
The visible face appears longer than it is wide, with a relatively straight vertical orientation and a balanced width between the upper and lower face.

The upper zone from hairline to brows appears moderately tall; the middle zone from brows to base of nose appears similar in height; the lower zone from base of nose to chin appears slightly fuller due to the visible jaw and chin area.
The forehead is visible and moderately broad, with a high, gently curved hairline partly covered by side-parted hair.
The eyes are evenly set and forward-facing; the brows appear light and relatively straight with a mild arch.
The nose appears straight from the frontal view, with a medium bridge width and a rounded tip.
The mouth is closed, with a mostly horizontal line; the lips appear medium-thin and symmetrical in this view.
The jawline appears fairly broad with a rounded-square chin, giving the lower face a stable, defined outline.

observation.retakeReason: No face is visible in the image; it shows an open hand/palm instead. Please provide a clear, front-facing face image with good lighting for a non-sensitive facial-structure observation.
